payload.recallText:
I grew up in Providence. We lived close to our neighbours, the kennedys who were catholics and were we, We used to be very close.
One evening after dinner and some argument at grandma's house we drove home when he heard news of kennedys asssasination.
I started to tear up, and my sister called Dad, hinting to him that i was crying. My Dad looked back at me and told me not to cry again for a man like that.
My Dad had done an amazing wedding and had given Mom quite the Jewellery during their wedding celebration.
